Test Scenario: Timeline matches seller, rider and sorting center updates
Preconditions: Logged in as Buyer 1. A COD order to ADDR-2 (Makati, Area B, delivered by Rider 2) is Ready for Pickup.
Test Steps:
1. Logistics 1 assigns Rider 1 for the pickup; Rider 1 picks up and drops the parcel at the sorting center (HUB-QC), which scans it in, sorts it to Area B and assigns Rider 2; Rider 2 collects it and goes Out for Delivery.
2. Pull to refresh Buyer 1's order after each step.
Expected Result: Each event appears once, in order, with its time: Picked Up, At Sorting Center, Sorted, Assigned to Rider, Out for Delivery. The order moves to To Receive at Picked Up.

Test Scenario: Full order flow from the ERP: placed to completed
Preconditions: Buyer 1 is Approved. Seller 1 has P-02 in stock (20). Logistics 1, Rider 1 (Area A, Online) and Rider 2 (Area B, Online) are Active.
Test Steps:
1. Buyer 1 places a COD order for P-02 to ADDR-2.
2. Seller 1 accepts, prepares and packs it, and marks it Ready for Pickup.
3. Logistics 1 assigns Rider 1; Seller 1 hands over and confirms; Rider 1 scans the waybill.
4. Rider 1 delivers the parcel to the sorting center; it is scanned in, sorted to Area B and assigned to Rider 2.
5. Rider 2 collects it, goes Out for Delivery and delivers with the photo, OTP and COD.
6. Buyer 1 taps Order Received.
Expected Result: Each role sees the statuses in this order, once each, with times: Placed, Confirmed, Preparing, Ready for Pickup, Picked Up, At Sorting Center, Sorted, Assigned to Rider, Out for Delivery, Delivered, Completed. Buyer 1's tab goes To Ship, then To Receive at Picked Up, then Completed. Only the roles involved are notified at each step. P-02 stock is 19 and Seller 1's earnings become Available at Completed.
